purpose: Second Dallas production-readiness gate: verify that roster authority, player namespaces, authored action coverage and Gamecast fallback behavior remain internally consistent before final Dallas closure.

qaChecks.assert: The authoritative 53 active roster slugs map one-to-one to Dallas player namespaces; no production identity may alias another player's folder.
Every Gamecast-eligible action for a player must be present in that player's roster.json action inventory even when an archetype contains additional authored poses.
A personalized render is ineligible unless its appearance specification is locked to a current official headshot; unresolved appearance must fall back without guessing skin tone or visible traits.
The visible uniform number must agree with roster.json for the resolved player identity; mismatch fails closed for personalized display.
Base, action and celebration assets preserve realistic 3D chibi style, canonical camera family, lighting family, scale, transparent alpha and foot anchor.
Position actions transition through authored start/contact/recovery states without identity swaps, anchor jumps or duplicate football ownership.
Only the two project-verified Dallas named signatures are eligible by name; all other celebrations remain generic/team/player-specific only when independently verified and recorded.
Failure or absence of a signature asset can never change the authoritative first-down, sack, touchdown or other play result.
The same authoritative play revision cannot consume an action or signature twice because of repeated polling, reconnect or rerender.
An authoritative correction clears stale animation, participant and football state before deterministic reconstruction from corrected truth.
Participant overflow degrades deterministically to principal chibis plus existing Gamecast presentation rather than overcrowding or dropping authoritative event information.
All QA state, asset keys, caches and fallbacks remain under NFL/DAL namespaces and cannot mutate MLB or NHL behavior.

failureMatrix.behavior: Use existing non-personalized Gamecast representation; never substitute another Dallas player.
Do not render a guessed personalized chibi; use safe fallback.
Reject personalized asset and preserve authoritative text/data presentation.
Route to nearest eligible generic action or existing Gamecast presentation.
Preserve play truth and use eligible generic celebration/recovery.
Fail open to existing Gamecast without affecting live state.
Invalidate stale scene state and reconstruct once from corrected revision.

acceptanceFixtures.assert: Exactly 53 authoritative active roster identities are expected and each resolves uniquely.
A missing asset for one player can never display another player's face, number or personalized animation.
Missing official-headshot provenance blocks personalized rendering rather than triggering name-based appearance inference.
Archetype-only actions absent from a player's roster inventory are rejected.
Base-to-action-to-recovery keeps the same canonical ground contact within production tolerance.
Pass, catch, fumble and recovery choreography never renders two authoritative footballs.
CeeDee Lamb first-down nose-wipe is eligible once per qualifying authoritative revision.
Von Miller DeSoto Shuffle is eligible once per qualifying authoritative sack revision.
An unverified named signature for any other Dallas player is denied by the release gate.
Reconnect reconstructs the current scene without replaying already-consumed celebrations.
Corrected participant or play result invalidates stale personalized choreography before reconstruction.
Dallas QA and fallback paths perform no writes to MLB or NHL assets, caches, state or runtime behavior.

next: Continue Dallas QA with qa-03; do not begin Philadelphia until Dallas quality work is explicitly closed in project.json.
